SuperAdmin.title: SuperAdmin
SuperAdmin.description: Represents the Super Admin of the ParkX platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Super Admin entity.

email.description: Email address of the Super Admin.

firstName.description: First name of the Super Admin.

lastName.description: Last name of the Super Admin.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a vendor (parking lot business) on the ParkX platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vendor entity.

email.description: Contact email address for the vendor.

isPrivileged.description: Grants the vendor special, elevated permissions.

parkingSpotLimit.description: Maximum number of parking spots allowed for the vendor.

status.description: Status of the vendor (e.g., Pending, Active, Trial).

trialEnds.description: The date the vendor's trial period ends.

logoUrl.description: URL of the vendor's company logo.

EndUser.title: EndUser
EndUser.description: Represents an end-user (customer) of a vendor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the End User entity.

cancellationRequested.description: Flag indicating if the user has requested to cancel their spot.

cancellationRequestDate.description: The date the user requested cancellation.

truckParkingSpots.description: Number of truck parking spots assigned to the user.

isRecurringPayment.description: Flag indicating if the user is on a recurring payment plan.

truckCompanyName.description: The name of the user's truck company.

truckUnitNumber.description: The unit number of the user's truck.

vinNumber.description: The VIN of the user's truck.

tagNumber.description: The license plate or tag number of the user's truck.

waiverSigned.description: Indicates if the user has signed the liability waiver.

waiverSignedDate.description: The date the user signed the waiver.

profileComplete.description: Indicates if the user has completed the initial profile setup.

vehicleYear.description: The year of the user's vehicle.

vehicleMake.description: The make of the user's vehicle.

vehicleModel.description: The model of the user's vehicle.

licensePlate.description: The license plate of the user's vehicle.

trailerPlate.description: The trailer plate of the user's vehicle, if any.

ParkingSpot.title: ParkingSpot
ParkingSpot.description: Represents a parking spot within a vendor's parking lot.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Parking Spot entity.

name.description: Name or identifier of the parking spot (e.g., 'A1', 'Spot 10').

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether the parking spot is currently available.

userId.description: The ID of the EndUser assigned to this spot.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Represents a conversation thread between two users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Conversation entity.

participants.description: An array of user IDs who are part of the conversation.

lastMessage.description: A copy of the last message for display purposes.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a conversation.

VendorInvoice.title: VendorInvoice
VendorInvoice.description: Represents an invoice for a vendor, covering subscriptions and additional services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vendor Invoice.

vendorId.description: The ID of the vendor this invoice belongs to.

vendorName.description: The name of the vendor (denormalized for display).

amount.description: The total amount of the invoice.

dueDate.description: The date the invoice is due.

status.description: The current status of the invoice (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue).

notes.description: Additional notes or line items for the invoice.

UserInvoice.title: UserInvoice
UserInvoice.description: Represents an invoice from a Vendor to an End User for parking services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User Invoice.

vendorId.description: The ID of the vendor who issued this invoice.

userId.description: The ID of the user this invoice belongs to.

userName.description: The name of the user (denormalized for display).

amount.description: The total amount of the invoice.

dueDate.description: The date the invoice is due.

status.description: The current status of the invoice (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue).

notes.description: Additional notes or line items for the invoice.

UserDocument.title: UserDocument
UserDocument.description: Represents a document associated with a user, such as a signed waiver or a spot change record.

name.description: The name of the document, e.g., 'Parking Agreement' or 'Spot Change Record'.

content.description: The full text or content of the document.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the document was created.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure has been updated to use a top-level `/users` collection for End Users. This is a best practice that ensures fast, scalable, and secure user role lookups during login, eliminating the need for expensive and permission-prone collection-group queries. Each user document in the `/users` collection contains a `vendorId` field to maintain its relationship with a vendor, which is used for authorization in security rules. A new sub-collection `userInvoices` has been added under `/vendors/{vendorId}` to store billing records from a vendor to their users, ensuring that a vendor can only access their own financial data. A new sub-collection 'userDocuments' has been added to store signed waivers and other documents for users, accessible by the vendor. The messaging system is refactored to use a top-level `/conversations` collection with a `messages` sub-collection, which is a more scalable and secure pattern for chat applications.
